spans.s:
भुय्य भुय्य, अस्, m., N. of a person men-
tioned in Rāja-taraṅgiṇī

भूय, अम्, n. becoming, being, existence, con-
dition, state, abstract state, (at the end of comps., cf.
अमुत्र-भ्˚, आत्म-भ्˚, देव-भ्˚, ब्रह्म-भ्˚.)

1. भूयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (for 2. भूयस् see col. 3),
becoming; (अस्), n. the act of becoming; [cf.
ब्रह्म-भ्˚.]

भूयस् 2. भूयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (according to
Pāṇini

, compar. of बहु, q. v.; for 1.
[]
भूयस् see p. 718, col. 2), more, more numerous,
more abundant; greater, larger, mightier; more im-
portant; much, many, numerous; very great, impor-
tant; vehement, severe; abounding in, abundantly
furnished with (with inst., e. g. गुणैर् भूयान्,
abounding in qualities); (अस्), ind. more, most, very
much, much, exceedingly, largely, over and above,
still more, more and more, further on, further, be-
sides, moreover, even; again, anew, afresh, fre-
quently, repeatedly; भूयो भूयः, again and again;
पूर्वम् — भूयः, first — next; in the first place —
in the next place; (असा), ind. very much, exceed-
ingly, beyond measure, excessively, in a high degree;
mostly, generally, as a general rule; [cf. Hib. bhus,
a sign of the comparative degree, always having ni
before it, as ni bhus airde, ‘higher.’]
—भूय-शस्,
ind. mostly, generally, as a general rule, commonly;
again, anew, afresh.
—भूयस्-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, or
भूयस्-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. making or doing more;
augmenting, increasing.
—भूयस्-तरम् or भू-
यस्-तराम्, ind. more, anew, afresh, again.
—भू-
यस्-त्व, अम्, n. ‘moreness,’ the being more or
greater, muchness, a large quantity, abundance, mul-
titude, manifoldness, multiplicity; majority, prepon-
derance, surplus, surplusage, overplus.
—भूयो-विद्य,
अस्, आ, अम्, knowing more, more learned.

भूयस्विन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. more numerous or
abundant; superior.

भूयिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. of बहु), most,
most numerous, most abundant; very abundant
or numerous, many, much, very great, very, (भू-
यिष्ठे निकटे, very near, in the closest proximity);
chief, principal, most important; consisting principally
of, chiefly filled with or characterized by (= प्राय,
often at the end of comps., e. g. शूद्र-भ्˚, q. v.;
अहङ्कार-दर्प-भूयिष्ठ, chiefly characterized
by or filled with egotism and pride); nearly all,
almost, (especially after a past passive part., e. g.
गत-भूयिष्ठ, almost gone; cf. निर्वाण-भ्˚);
(अम्), ind. for the most part, mostly, almost, chiefly;
abundantly or numerously, in the highest degree,
very much; (एन), ind. for the most part, mostly.
—भूयिष्ठ-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. sharing princi-
pally, enjoying the largest share, receiving most.
—भूयिष्ठ-शस्, ind. in very large numbers, very
numerously.
भूरि भूरि. See p. 718, col. 2.
